Full adversarial review 05/10/2026 after corrections. Read all 51 pinned Pāli segments, every project Vietnamese segment/comment, the complete pinned English reference (98% of substantive Pāli segments; the small remaining Sujato gap was not treated as agreement), and the full Vietnamese TMC/Bình Anson text at https://www.budsas.org/uni/u-kinh-trungbo/trung06.htm. Pāli authority is bilara commit 11c9d708978cde8ba61096d8a75f7ddfb846f639; TMC/Budsas is a whole-text third-party copy under NOASSERTION, not segment aligned.

Adversarial pass checked the opening discipline formula, all 17 successive wishes and repeated practice clause, all four mental-state axes in 16.2–16.17, the counts and scope in stream-entry/once-returner/non-returner, each psychic ability, past-life details, karma and destinations, and release from the three defilements. Fixed before scoring: opening locative Sāvatthiyaṁ now says “ở Sāvatthī” without importing English “near”; wish `piyo/manāpo/garu/bhāvanīya` now preserves dear/pleasant/respected/esteemed distinctions after direct DPD/TMC comparison; `paricca pajānāmi` now carries both encompassing with mind and knowing clearly; the final abhiññā formula is reordered to distinguish direct realization, entry/attainment, and abiding in both liberations. Reviewed each changed segment and surrounding repetition in the full text.

The TMC whole-text account agrees with the list’s scope and canonical terms; it was used as a prose reference only. Summary wording is similarly aligned; its four paragraphs represent the 20 descriptive wishes as categories without claiming they are exhaustive quotations. No known high-impact semantic error remains in translation/summary. Technical release blocker remains: tests and validator fail on missing DN15–34 summaries and two untracked English fills (AN4.108/AN4.110) without required metadata. Score 2 for technical integrity records that observed global gate failure; publication must remain draft.

assessments.notes:
Full summary review 05/10/2026 against the complete MN6 root, translation, comments and English reference. It captures the opening training standard and the repeated principle for each wish; distinguishes wishes for material support, the supporters’ merit and relatives’ benefit, mastering discontent/fear, absorptions and formless release, noble attainments, psychic abilities and three knowledges, ending with the Buddha’s return to discipline. It correctly keeps the successive “wish” formula tied to completing the training rather than presenting wishes as sufficient causes. It preserves the order of the three knowledges and the last result, and does not import later commentary. Prose has four paragraphs and is within the repository’s summary length/format contract.

Global technical blocker remains: repository tests/validator fail on incomplete DN summaries and untracked English-fill metadata. This prevents a clean release score, recorded as a blocker.
